                       input=json.dumps(req).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                       stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd='/workspace')

def case(initial, tx, bursts, cp, costs):

                       'cache_pages': cp, 'costs': {'hit': costs[0], 'miss': costs[1],
                                                    'decode': costs[2]}}]}
